text: RCA: Pune FTTH Regional Outage (INC-2026-0179) Document ID: RCA_INC_2026_0179 Category: C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services Department: Network Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Incident Summary A construction excavation severed a primary fibre trunk, affecting ~2,800 broadband customers for approximately 5.7 hours. Incident Reference: INC-2026-0179 Business Impact Customer-facing impact and any associated complaint/refund volume are tracked in the linked incident record and customer-care systems. Technical Impact Affected systems/sites and the duration of degraded or unavailable service are as recorded in the linked incident report. Detection Detected via monitoring/alarms or customer reports as documented in the linked incident report. Timeline Root Cause The affected trunk route lacked route diversity, meaning a single cut caused a full regional outage with no automatic failover path. Contributing Factors Splicing team dispatch relied on a single on-call technician for the region. Route-diversity investment for this corridor was previously deprioritised due to lower customer density at the time of original build. Five Whys Why did the fault occur? Root cause as above. Why wasn't it prevented? Existing safeguards did not cover this failure mode. Why not? The scenario had not previously been observed at this scale, prompting the corrective actions below. Resolution Service was restored per the incident timeline; see linked incident report for full detail. Corrective Actions Prioritise route-diversity build-out for the Pune regional trunk given increased customer density (target: 6 months, capital planning required). Increase on-call splicing technician coverage for the region to at least two available
